summary.text: Mark Born is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 37 and a co-chair of the Joint Finance Committee, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat LaToya Bates.

paragraphs.text: Mark Born was born in Beaver Dam, Wisconsin, and earned a high school diploma from Beaver Dam High School and a bachelor's degree from Gustavus Adolphus College.
His career experience includes working in law enforcement.
Born won Assembly District 39 general elections in 2018, 2020 and 2022, and District 37 in 2024, when he defeated LaToya Bates.
For 2025-2026 he is co-chair of the Joint Finance Committee and also sits on the Audit, Employment Relations and Rules committees.
